There are no stats, rankings, guarantees or testimonials.

- **House style:** No banned words or AI tells. It's short, concrete and plain. The policy has no voice section, so I couldn't score it against a brand voice.
- **Disclosure:** This is the brand's own product page, with no ads, affiliate links, gifted products or AI-generated content, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing unresolved. One note: "around 40 cups" depends on how much tea goes into each cup, so check it against your standard brewing measure.
